name: CANON_V2-Surveys T2
text_html:
CANON V2-Surveys (REDCap event visit_2_arm_1), in this order:

  1. Big Five Inventory (BFI)
  2. Temporal Experience Of Pleasure Scale (TEPS)
  3. Comprehensive Inventory Of Thriving (CIT)
  4. Scale of Unpredictability Beliefs (SUB)
  5. Valuing Happiness Scale (VHS)
  6. Panic Disorder Severity Scale (PDSS)
  7. WHO: Health And Work Performance (WHOHPQ)
  8. Patient Health Questionnaire (PHQ-9)
  9. Adult Rejection Sensitivity Questionnaire (A-RSQ)
  10. Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD-7)
  11. WHO: Disability Assessment Screen (WHODAS)
  12. Brief Fear of Negative Evaluation Scale (BFNE-S)
  13. Behavioral Inhibition System/Behavioral Approach System (BIS/BAS)
  14. Rosenberg Selfesteem Scale (RSE)
  15. Liebowitz Social Anxiety Scale Self-Report (LSAS-SR)
  16. Childhood Trauma Questionnaire (CTQ)
  17. Drug Abuse Screening Test (DAST-10)
  18. Stanford Sleepiness Scale – Modified (SSS)
